descriptions.zh:
我们成功地恢复了[gateway_system.GetName]星系中远古星门的供能！尽管年代久远，这座装置还是形成了一条完全可以供通行的稳定亚空间通路。

我们还检测到了异常的、类似于进出星门时的能量读数，但没有任何船只过境的迹象。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

We're also detecting unusual energy readings, similar to those that occur when entering or exiting a gate, but without any evidence of a ship in transit.

descriptions.zh:
一艘巨大的舰船从星门中出现，它的体积之巨大我们前所未见。军队已处于高度戒备状态。

那艘未知舰船对我们的呼叫没有应答，但鉴于它似乎完全处于瘫痪状态，我们暂时不会与它交战。我们仍在进行调查并试图开启通讯。
descriptions.en:
A hulking ship has emerged from the gate, its sheer scale unlike anything we have seen before. Military forces have been put on high alert.

The unknown vessel is not responding to our hails, but given the fact that it appears completely disabled, we will not engage it for now. Investigation and attempts to open comms continue.

trigger:
fire_only_once = yes
is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们对这艘巨大舰船的调查并没有得到很多信息。然而，我们已经能够破译星门第一次打开时收到的一些数据。看来，这艘舰船已经被困在星门里一段时间了（可能久得难以想象）。

为了了解更多，我们需要登上它。由于这是一艘军舰，建议派遣特种部队。
descriptions.en:
Our investigation into the hulking ship hasn't yielded many answers. However, we have been able to decipher some of the data we received when the gate first opened. It appears that the ship has been stuck inside the gate for an unknown (and possibly incredible) length of time.

To find out more, we will need to board the ship. As it is a military vessel, sending a special ops unit is advised.

descriptions.zh:
在登上舰船后不久，我们就遭遇了一队异形的外星人。由于我们的突然出现，许多外星人受到了惊吓，纷纷拔出武器。谢天谢地，交火得以避免！

在要求双方冷静下来之后，外星人指挥官解释道这艘船需要进行紧急维修。一旦所有系统正常运转，他和他的船员打算返回自己的母星，斯卡拉维德。

这位指挥官全身着军队盛装礼服，其形象十分令人深刻。这艘舰船的船员在提及他时都满怀敬意，其个人魅力甚至影响到了我方人员。他已经营造了双边建立正式外交关系的可能性。
descriptions.en:
Soon after boarding the vessel, we encountered a group of uniformed aliens. Startled by our sudden appearance, many were quick to draw weapons. Thankfully, a firefight was avoided.

Calling for calm, the alien commander explained that the ship is in need of emergency repairs. Once all systems are operational, he and his crew intend to return to their home planet, Skravird.

Dressed in full military regalia, he certainly cuts an impressive figure. The ship's crew speak of him with reverence, and the force of his personality is palpable even to our people. He has already raised the possibility of establishing formal diplomatic relations.

descriptions.zh:
在舰船的内部，我们发现了一支外星人团队，他们正在尝试修复舰船的功能。我们的突然出现让他们感觉受到了威胁，许多外星人很快拔出了武器。尽管避免了冲突，这位外星人指挥官显然还是把我们当做了敌人。

他身着全套军服，器宇不凡。即便在我们看来，他的人格魅力也是显而易见的。然而，目前似乎很难进行进一步的沟通。
descriptions.en:
Inside the vessel, we discovered a group of aliens working to restore the ship's functionality. Viewing our sudden appearance as a threat, many were quick to draw weapons. Although violence was avoided, the alien commander clearly views us as adversaries.

Dressed in full military regalia, he cuts an impressive figure. The force of his personality is palpable even to us. However, at this point further dialogue seems unlikely.

label.zh: 帮助指挥官修复他的舰船。
label.en: Help this commander repair his ship.

label.zh: 无视他。转而扣押这艘舰船。
label.en: Ignore him. Seize the ship instead.

descriptions.zh:
我们的工程团队已经对外星人船员提供了援助。这艘船的番号大致可以翻译作“利爪一号”，外星指挥官自称斯克兰德·夏普比克，是一位享有盛名的海军上将。

通过对比利爪一号和我们自己的数据，我们确认斯克兰德和他的船员被困在星门里长达几千年。对他们来说，这是一次短暂的旅行，但对星系的其他地方来说，几千年已经过去了。

得益于我们对斯卡拉维德的发掘，至少我们已经能向夏普比克司令指出他故乡星球的所在了，但他曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
descriptions.en:
Our engineering team has ably assisted the alien crew. The vessel's designation translates roughly to 'First Talon', and their commander has identified himself as Skrand Sharpbeak, an admiral of renown.

By comparing data from the First Talon's databanks and our own, we have confirmed that Skrand and his crew were trapped within the gate for several millennia. For them, it was a short trip - but for the rest of the galaxy, thousands of years passed by.

Thanks to our excavation on Skravird, at least we can point Admiral Sharpbeak towards his home planet, but everything and everyone he has have ever loved is long since gone.

他们无家可归，他们曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
descriptions.en:

By comparing data from the First Talon's databanks and our own, we have confirmed that Skrand and his crew were trapped within the gate for several millennia. For them, it was a short trip - but for the rest of the galaxy, thousands of years passed by.

They have no home to return to. Everything and everyone they have have ever loved is long since gone.

descriptions.zh:
§H利爪一号的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克向我们打了个招呼。他显得精疲力竭。§!

斯卡拉维德陷落了。我的家园不复存在了。数十亿的生命……逝去了。

利爪一号就这么变成了最后一艘利爪号，而我也变成了一个无依无靠的士兵。感谢你们的帮助，我代表我的船员宣誓效忠。
descriptions.en:
§HAdmiral Skrand Sharpbeak of the First Talon hails us. He appears exhausted.§!

Skravird has fallen. My home is no more. Billions of lives... gone.

The First Talon has become The Last Talon, and I am a soldier without a cause. For your help, and on behalf of my crew, I pledge our allegiance.

label.zh: 谢谢。但我们也有值得尊敬的指挥官。
label.en: Our thanks. But we have worthy commanders of our own.

label.zh: 那你有什么能耐阻止我们据为己有吗？
label.en: What is to prevent us from simply taking it ourselves?

descriptions.zh: 我们的士兵轻易地战胜了外星舰船的船员。我们摧毁了他们的防御，清理掉了舰桥上的敌军士兵。这艘船是我们的了！
descriptions.en: Our troops easily overpowered the vessel's crew. We destroyed their defenses and cleared the bridge of enemy soldiers. The ship is ours!

descriptions.zh: 我方登录外星舰船的部队遭到了残虐！敌人令人难以置信地凶悍。结束战斗后，我们重启了舰船的战术系统。系统显示，超光速引擎仍然无法启动，但舰船本身正在主动争夺我们的控制权。
descriptions.en: Our troops aboard the alien vessel were decimated! The ferocity of the defenders was incredible. After the battle, power was returned to the ship's tactical systems. According to our scans, the hyperdrive is still inoperable, but the vessel itself is actively contesting our space.

descriptions.zh:
随着一种新型瘟疫在舰船上散播开来，利爪一号上的船员们开始陷入恐慌。根据初步的分析判断，对于我们的族群而言，这是一种相对无害的病毒。然而，对于船上的鸟类船员来说情况就不一样了，病毒首先附着在羽毛上，导致羽毛根部感染腐烂，不出几天，感染就会蔓延到血液中。

如果任由这样发展下去，最终会达到不可挽回的地步。
descriptions.en:
Panic grips the crew of the First Talon as a novel disease is sweeping across the ship. According to initial analysis, it's a strain of a relatively harmless virus, common to our people. However, to the avian crew of the Talon, its effects are both serious and disturbing. First manifesting in the plumage, the virus causes feathers to rot at the root. Within days, the rot spreads to the blood.

Over time, it is likely to prove fatal.

options.script: name = "paragon.3010.a"

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们用尽全力，但斯克兰德还是倒在了坏羽病的侵袭之下。他的同伴们正准备为此举行一场传统的葬礼仪式。
descriptions.en: Despite our best efforts, Skrand has succumbed to Feather Rot. His crew are preparing a traditional funeral service.

options.script:
name = TERRIBLE
destroy_situation = this

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们在利爪一号上采取了严格的隔离措施，但根据斯克兰德刚刚的报告，估计船上约有60%的船员已被感染。
descriptions.en: Despite our best efforts to quarantine the First Talon, Admiral Skrand has contracted a severe case of Feather Rot. We estimate that 60% of his crew is already sick.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 到目前为止，坏羽病的新症状几乎在一夜之间就涌现出来了，这超出了利爪一号自身医务室的处理极限，船上的走廊里挤满了病患还有奄奄一息的船员。
descriptions.en: Hitherto unseen symptoms of the Feather Rot epidemic have appeared almost overnight. The First Talon's sickbay is overflowing, and the ship's corridors are full of the sick and dying.

options.script: name = WORRYING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 舰船已经汇报了坏羽病导致的第一例死亡病例。那些鸟类船员目前仍然无法抵御病毒的感染，除非我们能找到治疗方法，不然的话据推算最终死亡率可达95%。
descriptions.en: The first fatalities of the Feather Rot epidemic have been reported. The avians remain unable to fight off the infection on their own, and unless we find a way a cure, we estimate a mortality rate of 95%.

options.script: name = DISCONCERTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 在数月的努力后，我们成功治愈了利爪一号上染病的船员们，舰船运转逐步重回正轨。毫无疑问斯克兰德将非常感谢我们在这件事上的帮助。
descriptions.en: After months of work, we were able to administer a successful treatment to the crew of the First Talon. Efforts are underway to up production. Admiral Skrand will no doubt be very grateful for our help in this matter.

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
destroy_situation = this

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们的人员一直在努力促进与斯克兰德和他的船员的关系。这种跨文化交流的努力已经取得初步成效：刚刚斯克兰德同意提供他们高效舰载机的设计。这可能会大大提升我们对太空作战的理解。
descriptions.en: Our personnel have worked hard to foster relations with Skrand and his crewmates. This effort in cross-cultural exchange is already bearing fruit: Skrand has just agreed to hand over the designs for their highly efficient strike craft. This could lead to a great leap in our understanding of space combat.

label.zh: 我们对该礼物表达感激
label.en: We are thankful for this gift.

descriptions.zh: 历时数月的研究、编写和实验终于提供了一些启发。外星飞船的计算机库包含了舰载机编队的适应性战术。现在这项技术由我们来运用。
descriptions.en: Months of studying, cataloging, and experimenting finally provided some insight. The alien vessel's computer banks contain adaptive tactics in strike craft formation. Now, this technology is ours to implement.

options.script:
name = "paragon.3021.a"
add_research_option = tech_strike_craft_skrand

descriptions.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
descriptions.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

tooltips.zh: §L如果在这个问题上选择斯克兰德，我们可能会面临更多的反弹。§!
tooltips.en: §LWe might face more backlash if we settle with Skrand on this issue.§!

descriptions.zh:
虽然我们的基层军官和指挥官正在与斯克兰德密切合作，但他们也不是完全言听计从。双方所习惯的指挥结构不同，带来了一些不必要的紧张局面。因此我们亟需一场联合军事演练。

该演练可能会降低我们指挥舰队的能力，但不能准备好军队的话可能会导致极其严重的后果。
descriptions.en:
Our officers and commanders are working closely with Skrand, but they are not always in accord with him. Their preferred command structures differ, causing unnecessary tension. This has precipitated a need for joint military training.

The work may limit our ability to command our fleets, but failing to properly prepare the troops could have dire consequences.

tooltips.zh: §L该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。§!
tooltips.en: §LThis project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.§!

label.zh: 这种军事演习有什么意义么。

descriptions.zh: 双方都取得了显著进展，我们认为联合演训项目取得了巨大成功。我们从斯克兰德那里学到了很多关于近距离太空作战的知识，同时他和他的军官们也熟悉了我们的后勤系统。一种新的乐观主义和同志情谊已经在军队中扎根下来。
descriptions.en: With exceptional progress on both sides, we consider the joint training program a great success. We learned much from Skrand about close-quarters space combat, while bringing him and his officers up to speed on our logistics practices. A new sense of optimism and camaraderie has taken root.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
主要问题在于我们使用舰载机的战术截然不同。斯克兰德部署了多个大型攻击机小组来打破敌人的指挥链。他们在母舰的明确目标下联合行动。

我们的方法则更灵活，让他们承担一些态势感知型的任务，并去执行高危险高回报的行动，但我们缺乏斯克兰德和他的军官所拥有的大局观。目前，我们还在努力寻找可以一起建立的共同基础。
descriptions.en:
The main problem lies in how differently we employ strike-craft tactics. Skrand deploys multiple large strike-craft teams to break the enemy's chain of command. They operate united by clear objectives from their mother ship.

Our approach is more flexible with roles dictated by situational awareness and the use of potentially high-risk, high-reward actions, but we lack the cohesion seen in Skrand and his officers. For now, we still strive to find a common ground to build on.

options.script: name = CURIOUS

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
模拟战斗表明，斯克兰德的集中火力战术在最初阶段非常奏效，但很快会被反制战术所克制。即便如此，他战果也还是比起我们的的表现好得多。

同时实施这两种战术会导致混乱。幸运的是，从这些失败中产生了可能想法，这将缓解潜在的问题。
descriptions.en:
Simulation battles have shown Skrand's concentrated tactics are very effective at first, but quickly fail against counter strategies. Even so, the results were superior to those we could expect ourselves.

Implementing parts of both tactics in parallel resulted in chaos. Fortunately, from these failures emerged promising ideas that should alleviate the underlying problems.

In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

tooltips.zh: §L采取这一行动将让所有异见者离开海军部。§!
tooltips.en: §LTaking this action will remove all dissidents from the admiralty.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们对利爪终号的联合研究得到了对这艘钢铁巨兽内部运作方式的独到见解。我们相信我们的研究团队跟利爪号的船员们通力合作将有可能进一步改进舰船的外部结构，让它面对攻击和船体破坏具有更强的抵抗力。

我们已经获得了斯克兰德的允许，但项目还需要更多资金。
descriptions.en:
Our joint research on the Last Talon has given us unique insights into the inner workings of this behemoth. We believe that our engineering team, in cooperation with those aboard the Talon, have an opportunity to further improve the outer layers of the ship, making it even more resistant to attacks and potential hull breaches.

We have already received permission from Skrand, but the project will require further funds.

tooltips.zh: §L该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。§!
tooltips.en: §LThis project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.§!

label.en: We don't have resources for this.

options.script: name = "paragon.3040.b"

descriptions.zh: 虽然我们没能完成预定目标，但还是成功地改进了利爪号的装甲系统。我们的工程师还发现了可以用于改进我们自己舰船的灵感。
descriptions.en: Although we didn't achieve the desired results, we managed to improve the Talon's armor systems. Our engineers also found valuable insights that can be applied to improve our own ships.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们对改进利爪号的结构强度而不牺牲速度或机动性进行了诸多努力，但进展相当缓慢。斯克兰德的工程师虽然帮了我们很多忙，但是他们不愿意我们在没有密切监督的情况下实施我们的想法。尽管如此，工作仍在继续推进。
descriptions.en: We have made several different attempts to increase the Talon's structural integrity without compromising speed or maneuverability, but progress has been slow. The assistance of Skrands' engineers has been a great boon to us, but they are reluctant to implement our ideas without close supervision. However, work continues to move forward.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
利爪号的部分材料和我们的同类产品不同。这些合金的韧性更差，导致船体在安装额外的装甲板时意外断裂。驻船工程师对我们的监督是正确的，幸好意外发生时他们就在附近。

我们需要使用一些原来用于升级的材料来维修船体，这将会导致整个升级工作的延迟。
descriptions.en:
Some of the Talon's materials differ from our equivalents. Its alloy is much less flexible, which caused the hull to break unexpectedly during the installation of additional armor plates. The ship's engineers were right to oversee our work, and we were lucky they were nearby.

We had to use some of the materials allocated for improvements to repair the ship, which has in turn delayed the whole operation.

options.script:
name = UNFORTUNATE
add_situation_progress = -5

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H闪烁的屏幕上浮现出斯克兰德的指挥界面。这位舰队司令的羽翼蓬立，双眼发出锐利的目光。§!

这些……混账！他们只知道杀戮、破坏！

§H他愤怒地咬紧了喙，继续说。§!

我请求……不，我下令发起战争！我们不能让他们毁掉一切，让我们再次一无所有！我、我相信我们一起可以防止我人民所遭遇的悲剧再度重演。我已经准备好与你们分享我们所知道的一切。
descriptions.en:
§HThe screen flickers as Skrand's command deck appears. The admiral's feathers are ruffled, his sharp eyes flashing.§!

These... outsiders! They came here only to kill, to destroy!

§HClacking his beak furiously, he continues.§!

I request-- No, I DEMAND that we declare war! We can't let them destroy everything, not again! I... Together I believe we can prevent a repeat of what befell my people. I am ready to teach you everything we know.

label.zh: 你之前曾和这些威胁交过手吗？
label.en: Have you come into contact with this threat before?

descriptions.zh: 得益于斯克兰德对“威胁”作战的专长，及其提供的海量数据，我们现在面对这些涌现出来的天灾更加有备无患了。下一步就是将这些知识落到实处。
descriptions.en: Thanks to Skrand's expertise in warfare against the Menace, and the vast database he has provided, we are now much better equipped to deal with the emerging crisis. All that remains is to put this knowledge to good use.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们获得的数据库中可查询到一些斯克兰德的帝国时代这些威胁的作战方式实例。看来，他们使用的策略确实类似于我们今天所面对的那些。他们的舰队不使用正常的物流方案，通常是自给自足的。

更重要的是，干扰技术对他们不怎么起作用。破坏操作同样没有用。
descriptions.en:
The databanks we've accessed provide us with some examples of how the Menace fought during the time of Skrand's empire. It appears that they used tactics similar to those we face today. They rarely use standard logistical schemes, and their fleets are usually self-sufficient.

More importantly, jamming technology is not as effective against such forces. Sabotage operations are likewise useless.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 将我们与斯克兰德的数据进行对比得出了一些有趣的结论。似乎这些敌人相当地古板：它的大型舰队一次只聚焦在一个目标，而忽视其他所有的东西。我们应该可以识别他们的目标，并进行相应的防御。
descriptions.en: Comparing our own data to Skrand's, we have come to some interesting conclusions. It turns out that the enemy is quite inflexible: its largest fleets focus on one target at a time, to the exclusion of all else. It should be possible to identify such targets and defend accordingly.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 利爪号上的一群工程师帮传达了一条来自斯克兰德的指令。他们请求我们帮助维护利爪号的框架，并让我们的船坞做好修船的准备。如上所述，这些计划代价高昂。而且还有一个问题：考虑到这项工作的微妙性质，斯克兰德将不得不亲自监督该项目。
descriptions.en: A group of engineers from the Talon has delivered an order from Skrand himself. They requested help to maintain the Talon's frame and prepare our shipyards for potential repairs. As outlined, these plans would be a costly process. And there is one catch: given the delicate nature of the work, Skrand will have to oversee the project himself.

tooltips.zh: §L该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。§!
tooltips.en: §LThis project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.§!

options.script: name = "paragon.3060.b"

descriptions.zh: 在我们的帮助下，利爪号的工程师成功地对我们的船坞进行了复古改装，以对利爪号的内部结构进行研究。他们利用我们的实验性的设计改进了他们的超光速引擎，使得即使在发生船体严重损坏的情况下，舰船仍然能够跃迁。虽然使用这种引擎会导致几乎瞬间到达目的地，但是它也会杀死船上的所有人，并且可能使舰船在数年内无法使用。另一方面，如果舰船在战斗中损毁，我们依然能可以尝试激活这个系统并修复残骸。
descriptions.en: With our help, the Talon's engineers have retrofitted our shipyards to study the Talon's inner workings. Making use of our experimental designs they enhanced their FTL drives, which allow the ship to jump even after a critical hull breach. Although usage of this drive will result in almost instantaneous travel, it will also kill everyone on board and probably render the ship inoperable for years. On the other hand, if the ship is lost in battle, we can try to activate the system and recover the wreckage.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 在利爪号工程师团队的密切支持和监督下，我们成功地重建了船体。利爪号再度启航！
descriptions.en: With the close support and supervision of the Talon's engineering team, we were able to rebuild the hull. The Talon takes flight again!

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
destroy_situation = this

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 多亏了额外的安全系统以及紧急协议，斯克兰德的旗舰在受到严重损坏后仍成功进行了紧急超光速跃迁。尽管出现在我们首都星球上方的残骸几乎无法被识别为一艘舰船，但船体依然可以作为重建的基础。这些残骸现在正在船坞等待修理。或者，我们可以对船体进行材料回收。考虑到它的状态，即便是我们认定这艘舰船的残骸无法修复的，斯克兰德也会理解这个决定。
descriptions.en: Thanks to additional failsafe systems and emergency protocols, Skrands' flagship managed to enter emergency FTL even after taking critical damage. Although what appeared in the skies above our capital world is barely recognizable as a ship, the hull can serve as a basis for rebuilding. The remains are now waiting at the docks for repairs. Alternatively, we could the hull for materials. Given its state, even Skrand would understand the decision if we deemed the wreck impossible to repair.

label.en: Scrap it, we need the alloys.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 近期在基因工程方面的进展有助于重新恢复舰队司令斯克兰德的种族。也许暂时还不具有相应的基因多样性来确保他们继续繁衍，但用兼容的基因填补空白应该可以完成这项工作。我们现在只需要足够的资金就可以开始行动。
descriptions.en: Recent developments in genetic engineering could enable us to repopulate Admiral Skrand's species. We may lack the genetic diversity to make them fully capable of reproduction, but filling in the gaps with compatible genes should get the job done. All that is required to get started is adequate funding.

label.zh: 斯克兰德作出了很多贡献。他完全配得上这个。
label.en: Skrand has served us well. He deserves this much.

tooltips.zh: §L该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。§!
tooltips.en: §LThis project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.§!

label.en: We don't have time for this.

options.script: name = "paragon.3080.b"

descriptions.zh: 我们复制斯克兰德DNA的工作某种意义上还是成功了。尽管他们的外观完全一致，但是克隆体的基因组成与斯克兰德的完全不同，它们构成了一个新物种。他们开始称自己为塔隆人。
descriptions.en: Our efforts to replicate Skrand's DNA have been more or less successful. Although their appearance is identical, the genetic makeup of the clones is different enough from Skrand's that they constitute a new species. We are told they have taken to calling themselves the Talons.

tooltips.zh: §L塔隆人将会出现在我们的母星上。§!
tooltips.en: §LThe Talons will appear on our homeworld.§!

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 斯克兰德的鸟类DNA远比预想的要顽固，以至于有必要将其他鸟类的基因拼接起来。这个方法并不理想，但应该能让我们完成这项工作。
descriptions.en: Skrand's avian DNA is far more rigid than expected, so much so that it has been necessary to splice genes from other avian species. The approach is not ideal, but it should allow us to finish the job.

options.script: name = WORRYING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H斯克兰德的制服一尘不染，他的羽翼油光发亮。§!

我已经看到了你们小小基因实验的成果。虽然这些克隆体还差强人意，但我相当感谢你们的努力。
descriptions.en:
§HSkrand's uniform is in perfect condition, his feathers well groomed.§!

I saw the result of your little genetic experiment. These clones are far from perfect, but I am grateful for your attempt.

label.en: We are sorry to hear that.

response_text = paragon.3083.a.response

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了一份来自许多利爪号船员的请求。他们要求我们调配资源研究他们民族的过往。在利爪号徘徊于亚空间的时候发生了许多许多事情。他们希望能为子孙后代记录下一些东西。
descriptions.en: We received a request from several members of the Talon's crew. They have asked us to use our resources to research their people's past. Much occurred while the Talon lay in limbo. They have asked that it be recorded for posterity.

tooltips.zh: §L该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。§!
tooltips.en: §LThis project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.§!

options.script: name = "paragon.3090.b"

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了关于斯克兰德和他的人民历史的第一份报告:

在他们的时代，星系广阔而未知，星系外边缘被视为太过危险，无法探索。

在星系中心周围，庞大的帝国在争夺权力。其中一个是鸟类文明。在其他人不敢涉足的黑暗之地，这些勇敢的探险家看到了机遇。大迁徙就这样开始了。
descriptions.en:
We have the first report on the history of Skrand and his people:

In their time the galaxy was vast and unknown, the outer rims considered too dangerous to explore.

Around the galactic center, vast empires vied for power. One was an avian civilization. Where others saw darkness, these intrepid explorers glimpsed opportunity. So began the Great Migration.

options.script: name = FASCINATING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
这里附上另一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

大迁徙在很久以前就结束了。偏安于星系的一隅，斯克兰德的人民们享受着和平而繁荣的日子。但成平日久的他们，没有做好应对威胁的准备。

攻击者不宣而战。没有一双翅膀来得及张开，尖牙立喙也失去了光芒。这些无面入侵者从太空而来，轰炸了鸟类的行星，留下了尸山血海。
descriptions.en:
Here follows another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The Migration was long over. Secure along the galaxy's outer rim, Skrand's kin enjoyed both peace and prosperity. But having traded vigilance for comfort, they were unprepared for the coming Menace.

The attackers came without warning. No wings were unfurled; neither talon nor beak flashed in combat. From space the faceless invaders bombed the avian worlds. In their wake they left only death.

options.script: name = FASCINATING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了下一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

斯卡拉维德的政府崩溃了，经济也在废墟中陷入停止。但人民的英勇丝毫未减。在远离前线的地方，一个项目正在酝酿之中。

一艘史无前例的舰船将被建造出来。其规模之大足以使敌人胆战心惊。当利爪一号准备就绪时，它被划入了斯卡拉维德最后一位指挥官的指挥之下。年轻又未经考验的斯克兰德·夏普比克上了战场。很快，他的人民就会把他称为威胁克星，斯卡拉维德的第一利爪。
descriptions.en:
We've received another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

Skravird's government collapsed. Its economy lay in ruins. But the valor of its people was undiminished. Far from the front lines, a project was hatched.

A ship would be built unlike any that had come before. Its sheer scale would strike terror into enemy. When the First Talon was ready, it was placed under the command of the last of Skravird's commanders. Young and untested, Skrand Sharpbeak went to war. Soon his people would hail him as Menace Bane, First Claw of Skravird.

options.script: name = FASCINATING

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
以下是斯克兰德和他的人民历史的最后一份汇报：

利爪一号，同时也是最后一号，穿过敌人的阵线。船员和指挥官的精明和勇敢带来了一场又一场的胜利。然而，它的航程是短暂的：即使是像利爪号这样的船，也不可能凭一己之力扭转战局。无奈之下，斯克兰德和他的军官们计划在斯克兰德的最后一次防御战中玉石俱焚。在一次包抄敌人的大胆行动中，斯克兰德命令利爪号进入一个未经测试的星门。他和利爪号便从此失去了音信。
descriptions.en:
Thus reads the final report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The First Talon, first and last of its line, cut through the enemy ranks. Battle after battle was won by the cunning and valor of its crew and their commander. Alas, its flight was short lived: no ship, not even one such as the Talon, could turn the tide of war on its own. In desperation, Skrand and his officers planned to sacrifice themselves in the last defense of Skravird. In a daring bid to outflank the enemy, Skrand ordered the Talon into an untested Gateway. Neither he nor the Talon were ever heard from again.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
刚一进入[From.GetName]恒星系，我们的传感器就发现了来自[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星的一个微弱信号。

它具有短促而重复的模式，看起来好像是在求救。然而，由于信号太过微弱，我们估计定位出其来源会相当困难。也许到时候就来不及伸出援手了。
descriptions.en:
On entering the [From.GetName] system our sensors detected a faint signal originating on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the signal's weakness, we expect that locating its source will prove difficult. It may already be too late to help.

label.zh: 如果还有机会就试试看。
label.en: If there's a chance, we have to take it.

options.script: name = paragon.3100.b

descriptions.zh:
我们在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上找到了求救信号的来源。

地壳深处埋藏着一个古老的逃生舱。它的冷冻胶囊仓里似乎有一个外星人幼体。

尽管这个逃生舱已经非常老了，但低温保存设备仍然在运行中，幼体的生命迹象也很稳定。在胶囊的外部粗略地刻着一系列符号。我们将其翻译成：“我们的希望。我们的未来。我们的子孙。”
descriptions.en:
We have found the source of the distress signal on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

Buried deep within the planet's crust was an ancient escape pod. Its cryostasis capsule contained what appears to be an alien child.

Despite the pod's extreme age, the cryopreservation equipment was still functioning, and the child's life signs are stable. On the capsule's exterior a series of symbols were roughly carved. We translated the symbols: 'Our hope. Our future. Our Scion.'

descriptions.zh:
在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上发现的孩子成功复苏了。所有的生命迹象都符合该类生命形式的合理范畴。目前他还没有恢复意识，也许还要一段时间才能苏醒。

在逃生舱内还发现了一些物品。第一件是一块略微损坏的数据水晶，记录了孩子的姓名、年龄和物种。他叫做§Y艾克萨凯德斯§!”，完整的日志表明他还是§Y瓦格罗的子嗣§!。第二件是一个由未知重金属构成的古怪文物。从该文物的设计上看，好像应该属于一个更大装置的一部分。进一步研究已正在计划中。

现在更紧迫的任务是要如何对待这个孩子。不管艾克萨凯德斯到底是，或者曾是什么人，目前来讲他需要照料。
descriptions.en:
The child discovered on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName] has been successfully resuscitated. All vital signs are within a reasonable range for a lifeform of its type. Still unconscious, it may be some time before the child wakes.

A number of items were also discovered inside the pod. The first was a degraded data crystal which revealed the child's gender, name, and species. He is called §YExakeides§!, and referred to throughout the log as the §Y'Scion of Vagros'§!. The second was a strange relic composed of an unknown, heavy material. Given its design, it is likely that this relic formed a part of a larger whole. Further study is advised.

Of more pressing concern is what to do with the child. Whoever this Exakeides is or was, for the time being he will require care.

label.zh: 我们会给艾克萨凯德斯一个家。
label.en: We will give Exakeides a home.

label.zh: 我们没有义务照顾这个孩子。
label.en: The child is not our responsibility.

descriptions.zh: 目前进行中的对艾克萨凯德斯身边的破损遗物的研究表明，它曾与障碍物发生过碰撞。由于丢失的部件过多，我们只能对其真实功能进行猜测。然而，根据近距离观测时记录的异常读数，我们有理由得出结论，该物体对时空有影响。
descriptions.en: Our ongoing research into the broken relic discovered with Exakeides has hit a roadblock. Given how many pieces are missing, we can only speculate on its true purpose. However, based on the anomalous readings we've recorded while in close proximity, there is some reason to conclude that the object has an impact on spacetime.

descriptions.zh:
§Y艾克萨凯德斯§!一直是一个非常早熟的孩子，随着十岁生日到来，他已经开始了更高级的学习。到目前为止，我们的重点一直是鼓励他无限的好奇心，并为他提供一切必要的工具来追求他的兴趣。在未来的几年里，他将由我们所能提供的最优秀的人才来指导。

他有潜力成为科学领域的领军人物，这足以证明我们的付出是会有回报的。问题是，要将他的教育将建立在什么基础上呢？
descriptions.en:
Always a remarkably precocious child, §YExakeides's§! tenth year marks the beginning of more advanced studies. Until now, our focus has been on encouraging his boundless curiosity and providing him with all the tools necessary to pursue his interests. In the coming years, he will be tutored by the best minds we have to offer.

His potential to become a leader in the sciences more than justifies the investment. The question is, upon what foundation will his education proceed?

label.en: Push him to embrace the unknown.

label.zh: 警告他不要相信陌生人。
label.en: Warn him not to trust in outsiders.

label.zh: 让他学会敬畏生命的价值。
label.en: Impress upon him the value of life.
Remind him that strength is power.

label.zh: 让他在物质世界脚踏实地。
label.en: Ground him in the physical world.

trigger:
fire_only_once = yes
is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
在二十岁时，§Y艾克萨凯德斯§!已经准备好承担其一位成年人的责任了。

从被复苏那一刻起，他就像一块海绵一样狂热而执着地吸收着我们的教导。尽管他已经具有海量的技艺和无边的智慧，但仍旧谦虚如初。

科学一直是他最热衷的领域，促动着它去发现自己的过往，以及那台与他一同被发现的破碎遗物。在他的同僚中，他的名字被简化为了“§Y凯德斯§!”。
descriptions.en:
On turning twenty years old, §YExakeides§! is ready to assume the responsibilities of adulthood.

In the time since his resuscitation, he has absorbed our teachings with fervor and determination. Despite his prodigious skill and a boundless intellect, he remains humble.

Science has long been his passion, fueling his drive to uncover the truth of his past as well as the purpose of the broken relic he was found with. To his peers, he is known simply as '§YKeides§!'.

label.zh: 是时候为他的下一步做规划了。
label.en: It is time to plan his next steps.

descriptions.zh:
你好。

§H凯德斯昂首站着，观察着形势，也在思考着自己对形势该作何反应。他的目光落在自己的双手上：那双手丝毫没有紧张的迹象，如磐石般沉稳。很明显他为这一天做了充分准备。§!

我准备好了。
descriptions.en:
Hello.

§HStanding tall, Keides observes the situation and his own response to it. His gaze falls to his hands: they are remarkably steady. He has prepared for this day.§!

I am ready.

descriptions.zh:
对遗物进行初步调查时，§Y凯德斯§!汇报了一段不同寻常的经历。

在进行物理接触后，他的脑海中出现了“幻视”；出现了人和地方的画面，是被埋在遥远过往的回忆。尽管他尚未完全理解其中的含义，但其中的一些画面描绘的是现实的地点。

凯德斯请求发起一个特殊项目对其进行探索。
descriptions.en:
Upon initial investigation of the relic, §YKeides§! has reported an unusual experience.

After physical contact, 'visions' have appeared in his mind; images of people and places, memories of a long forgotten past. Although he has yet to discern their full meaning, some of these visions depict real locations.

Keides is calling for a Special Project to explore them.

descriptions.zh: 进入[From.GetName]星系之后不久，我们很快就定位了一颗符合§Y凯德斯§!幻视的行星。在这颗行星的表面流淌着熔矿的海洋。
descriptions.en: Shortly after entry into the [From.GetName] system, a planet matching §YKeides§!'s vision has been located. Oceans of molten minerals stream across the planet's surface.

descriptions.zh:
在惊涛拍岸的熔岩海洋中，§Y凯德斯§!发现了一处矿物处理设施的遗迹。他报告有新的幻视：一条黑暗的走廊，通向一个密封的房间。根据这些影像，凯德斯找到了一个古老的、腐朽的盒子。盒子里面有一块残片，完全没有受到时间的摧残。

凯德斯汇报称，在接触到它的一瞬间，新的令人困惑的幻视立刻向他扑面而来。
descriptions.en:
Between the bays and swells of the planet's molten oceans, §YKeides§! discovered the remains of a mineral processing facility. He reported new visions of a dark corridor that led to a sealed room. Following these images led Keides to an ancient and moldering box. Inside the box, he found a fragment of the relic, untouched by the ravages of time.

Keides reports that upon touching it he was struck by a new and troubling vision.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y凯德斯§!的身边浮现出了一座巨大熔炉的轧制流程。矿物、工厂、载具覆盖着大地，航母编队在空中遮天蔽日。在噪音之外，还有数量惊人的传送门，忽明忽灭，可以折叠起来。突然，天地间传来一声巨大的轰鸣，连大地都开始震颤。远处传来一阵绞痛的尖叫声。

从视野中恢复过来后，凯德斯将新的碎片与现有的碎片放在一起。一声尖锐的啸叫充满了空气。几乎就在同时，这两块碎片就自动融合在一起了。于是这件遗珍的影响变得更加强烈了。
descriptions.en:
The milling activity of a great furnace rose around §YKeides§!. Mines, factories, and vehicles blanketed the ground. Huge carrier vessels dotted the skies. Beyond the noise, there was a staggering number of portals, blinking in and out of existence, folding in on themselves. Suddenly there was a great rumbling, and the ground began to shake. A strangled scream came from the distance.

After recovering from his vision, Keides set the new fragment alongside the existing piece. A sharp whine filled the air. Almost instantly, the two parts fused together of their own accord. The relic's effects appear strengthened.

descriptions.zh: 追踪着§Y凯德斯§!的幻视，我们来到了一颗位于[From.GetName]恒星系的行星。茂密的丛林覆盖了地面的90%。
descriptions.en: Following §YKeides§!'s vision has led us to a planet in the [From.GetName] system. Dense jungle covers more than 90% of its land area.

descriptions.zh:
野生丛林存在重重危险，要想安全地导航是十分困难的。§Y凯德斯§!不止一次从鬼门关逃了出来。

尽管如此，在一种神秘力量的吸引下，他仍继续前进，终于发现了一座巨大建筑的杂草丛生的遗迹。一个摇摇欲坠的楼梯井通向一座远高于林冠的基座。在那里的黑色金属底座上，有另一块遗物碎片。

几乎就在一瞬间，§Y凯德斯§!被拉入了幻视场景中。
descriptions.en:
The perils of the wild jungle have proven difficult to safely navigate. More than once, §YKeides§! has narrowly escaped the jaws of death.

Even so, drawn by a mysterious force, he pressed on, only to discover the overgrown remnants of a massive structure. A crumbling stairwell led to a pedestal far above the canopy. There, resting on a plinth of black metal, was another fragment of the relic.

Almost instantly, §YKeides§! was plunged into a vision.

descriptions.zh:
树木都散开了，取而代之的是一片苍翠的景色。这是一颗美丽而温顺的星球，有大型森林一般大小的动物围栏，包含了来自星系各处的物种。

突然，幻视把§Y凯德斯§!扯入进了一座大型建筑内的一个房间。其中一面墙描绘着数个恒星系的星图。其中四个星系与其他的明显不同，没有超空间航道连接。

从幻视中回到船上，§Y凯德斯§!把最新的一块遗物放在现有的部分旁边。它们发出嗡嗡声，肉眼可见地相互吸引，然后融合在一起。遗物的效果似乎加强了。
descriptions.en:
The vegetation peeled back, giving way to a green vista. A beautiful, tamed world, with animal enclosures the size of large forests, containing species from all over the galaxy.

Suddenly, the vision jolted §YKeides§! into a room inside a larger building. One wall depicted a map of several star systems. Four stood out clearly from the rest, unconnected by hyperlanes.

Back aboard the ship,§YKeides§! set the newest piece of the relic alongside the existing one. Humming, and visibly drawn towards one another, they fused. The relic appears strengthened.

descriptions.zh: 如§Y凯德斯§!的幻视一般，我们在伊弗施恒星系的一颗行星上观测到了一座舰船之冢。
descriptions.en: Just as in §YKeides§!'s vision, we have observed a graveyard of ships on a planet in the Ivusheh system.

descriptions.zh:
行星的碎裂表面四散着破旧的舰船。在最大的一处残骸堆中心，§Y凯德斯§!发现了一座巨大恒星基地的主框架。

把他带到这颗行星一样的不可抗拒的力量又出现了，牵引着§Y凯德斯§!走向基地内的一个房间。在被尘封的货仓中是遗物的另一个碎片。

在触碰到新发现的碎片的一瞬间，§Y凯德斯§!被拉入了一个幻视当中。
descriptions.en:
The planet's broken surface is littered with battered spacecraft. At the center of the largest debris field, §YKeides§! discovered the framework of a colossal starbase.

With irresistible power, the pull of whatever led §YKeides§! to the planet drew him to a single room inside the base. Among the dust-covered cargo waited another piece of the relic.

Upon touching the newfound fragment, §YKeides§! was plunged into another vision.

label.en: What did he see this time?

descriptions.zh:
一座围绕着这颗行星的恒星基地。其船坞中源源不断地涌出战列舰的编队。

在旗舰的甲板上，站立着一位年轻的舰队司令，一手握着一件与遗物相仿的物体。随着他手腕的一挥，飞船外的空间模糊、变暗，然后逐渐折叠显现出一个黑洞。当这位舰队司令命令舰队进入黑暗时，幻象突然结束了。

§Y凯德斯§!带着碎片回到船上，把它放在现有的碎片旁边。它们都开始发出刺耳的嗡嗡声振动起来。然后，在某种未知力量的作用下，两块融合成一体。事后，遗物的效果似乎加强了。
descriptions.en:
A vast starbase orbited the planet. From its docks flowed an unending procession of battleships.

On the deck of the flagship a young admiral stood, grasping in one hand an object resembling the relic. With a flick of his wrist, the space outside his ship blurred, darkened, then folded into itself as a black hole appeared. As the admiral ordered his fleet into the darkness, the vision abruptly ended.

Returning aboard with the fragment, §YKeides§! placed it next to the existing piece. Both began to vibrate with a piercing hum. Then, by some unknown force, the two pieces fused into one. After the fact, the relic's effects appear strengthened.

descriptions.zh:
在取回最后一块碎片后，遗物恢复如初，仿佛从未发生破碎一样。

随着遗物复原，对其目的进行研究迫在眉睫，且随时可以准备就绪。一项由§Y凯德斯§!抓总的特殊项目已经准备就绪。
descriptions.en:
After the retrieval of the final fragment, the relic appears as if it was never broken.

Upon the relic's restoration, research on its purpose is promising and ready to continue. A Special Project led by §YKeides§! has been prepared.

descriptions.zh:
对最近复原的遗物进行的研究带来了一些引人注目的发现。

它确实与§Y凯德斯§!有所联系：当与其瓦格罗基因接触时，遗物中的粒子会开始高频共振。尽管这背后的机制尚不清楚，但这种效应是时空操纵所体现的特征。

在数次尝试测量并控制该过程后，§Y凯德斯§!经历了又一次幻视。
descriptions.en:
Research into the recently restored relic has led to some intriguing discoveries.

Its connection to §YKeides§! has been affirmed. When in contact with his Vagrosian DNA, the relic's particles begin to resonate at high frequencies. Although the mechanics behind this remain unknown, the effects are symptomatic of space-time manipulation.

After several attempts to measure and control this process, §YKeides§! experienced another vision.

descriptions.zh:
§Y凯德斯§!描述了一种仿佛从里面看到遗物的感觉。恒星大小的粒子在他周围旋转。在两者间的虚空中，他经感受到一股力量涌了上来。仅凭双手，他就能指挥球体的运动。

§Y凯德斯§!从幻象中回来，把手放在了遗物上。现在他已经了解了它的用途，以及它惊人的能力：如果控制得当，它能使空间中的两点坍缩，创造一对稳定的虫洞。瓦格罗人称这种装置为§Y楔§!。

在他的发现的激励下，§Y凯德斯§!主动在我们的母星系中打开了一个虫洞。连他自己都不知道这条路通向哪里，但他仍然坚定，相信这很可能是他族人的家园。
descriptions.en:
§YKeides§! describes seeing the relic as if from within. Particles the size of suns swirled around him. In the void between, he experienced a surge of power. With his hands alone, he commanded the movements of the spheres.

Returning from this vision, §YKeides§! placed his hands on the relic. Now he understood its use, and the astonishing scope of its power. When properly controlled, it has the ability to collapse two points in space, effectively creating a stable wormhole. The Vagrosians called this device a §YKey§!.

Spurred by his discovery, §YKeides§! acted on his own initiative to open a wormhole in our home system. Not even he knows where it leads, but he remains resolute, believing it is likely his people's home.

label.zh: 让我们尽快找到答案吧。
label.en: Let us find out, sooner rather than later.

descriptions.zh:
遗物所生成的虫洞的另一端是瑟塞特星系。进入后不久，我们的传感器发现了一队有敌意的无人机。它们似乎在守护着这个星系唯一的一颗行星。初步的扫描结果显示，那些无人机上没有生命形式的信号，行星上同样也没有。

§Y凯德斯§!非常确信那颗行星就是他们民族的起源地。毫无疑问答案就在那里。

随后，无人机群向我们发出了通讯要求。
descriptions.en:
At the other end of the relic-spawned wormhole lies the Sursect system. Shortly after entry, our sensors picked up a fleet of hostile drones. They appear to be keeping vigil over the system's single planet. Initial scans suggest there are no life forms present among them, nor on the planet itself.

§YKeides§! has stated with certainty that the planet is indeed the origin of his people. It is sure to hold answers.

A demand from the drones to open comms follows.

descriptions.zh:
§H随着频道开启，尖锐的静电噪音与机器人模拟语音混合在一起。在一个周期内，每个声音都与下一个声音重叠，信息的音量在不规则的波中振荡。§!

动机：回收楔，违反章程。
瓦格罗之楔，状态：未收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：违反。

目标行为：归还楔。
应对方式：摧毁目标。
descriptions.en:
§HAs the channel opens, screeching static blends with a wash of robotic vocalization. In cycles each voice overlaps the next, the message's volume oscillating in irregular waves.§!

IMPETUS: key confiscation, charter breach.
VAGROSIAN KEY, STATUS: uncollected.
VAGROS-IMPERIAL CHARTER NO. 412, STATUS: in breach.

TARGET ACTION: return key.
COUNTERACTION: destroy target.

label.zh: 遗物是我们的。另寻他法。
label.en: The relic is ours. Find another way.

label.zh: 将楔交给他们。我们的安全是首位的。
label.en: Give them the Key. Our safety is the priority.

descriptions.zh:
§H合成语音的吱嘎声逐渐放慢，暂时停顿，然后继续说出最后几句话。§!

瓦格罗之楔，状态：紧急收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：暂时忽略。

行为：待机。
descriptions.en:
§HThe crackle of artificial voices is slowed, halting momentarily, then continues.§!

VAGROSIAN KEY, STATUS: collection imminent.
VAGROS-IMPERIAL CHARTER NO. 412, STATUS: tentatively omitted.

ACTION: hold.

descriptions.zh:
将楔交给那支舰队后，那些无人机立刻顺着一个它们自己的虫洞离开了。

在那之后，虫洞在它们身后关上了。我们现在可以自由地探索这个恒星系和里面的行星了。
descriptions.en:
Upon handing over the Key to the fleet, the drones promptly departed through a wormhole of their own.

Afterwards, the wormhole closed behind them. We are now free to explore the system and its planet.

label.zh: 我们做出了正确的选择。

options.script: name = paragon.3147.a

descriptions.zh:
我们发射了一股电磁脉冲，烧毁了这些无人机的电路。

我们现在可以自由探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
descriptions.en:
We delivered an electromagnetic pulse which fried the circuits of the drones.

We are now free to explore the Sursect system and its planet.

descriptions.zh:
尽管无人机群被击败了，但是它们的制造者也留了一手，让摧毁它们的人也捞不到什么好处。无人机在回应我们的攻击时，启动了自毁程序。残余的东西难以被打捞。

不过，我们现在可以自由地探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
descriptions.en:
Despite the drones' defeat, whoever created them made sure that no one could benefit from their destruction. The drones initiated self-destruct protocols in response to our attack. What little remains is hardly salvageable.

Still, we are now free to explore the Sursect system and its planet.

label.zh: 这仍然算得上是一场胜利。
label.en: This still counts as a victory.

descriptions.zh: 这颗行星在瓦格罗社会中一定扮演了至关重要的角色。在挖掘初期，很明显，大部分基础设施都以行政工作为中心，这座城市可能是一个通信枢纽。这里还有许多领导层碰面的地方，而且已经发现了几个极大规模的公共广场。
descriptions.en: The planet must have played a vital role in the Vagrosian society. Early into the excavations, it has become clear that much of the infrastructure was centered around administrative work, the city potentially serving as a hub for communications. There was no shortage of places for those in leadership to gather, and several public squares of truly massive proportions have already been uncovered.

options.script: name = paragon.3150.a

descriptions.zh:
因为很幸运地发现了一座地下保险库，§Y凯德斯§!兴奋得几天没睡着。他确信这个地方就隐藏着自己身世的秘密。

在保险库的深处，他发现了一排又一排的冷冻仓，但里面都是空的。集成在地板上的电路连向了一座更大的结构：在拱顶的中心有一个像王座一样的基座。
descriptions.en:
Thanks to the fortunate discovery of an underground vault, §YKeides§! has not slept for days. He is convinced that this place holds the key to his existence.

Deep within the vault, he discovered row upon row of cryostasis pods, all of them empty. Circuits integrated in the floor led to a larger structure: a throne-like pedestal at the very center of the vault.

label.zh: 真有意思。这是干什么用的？

options.script: name = paragon.3151.a

descriptions.zh:
不顾科学小组的抗议，§Y凯德斯§!毅然决定坐上那台王座般的机器。

他刚一坐下来就失去了知觉。

尽管他的表情变得放松，但他的身体却承受着剧烈的痉挛。科学小组再怎么努力也没能把他从王座上解救出来。几个小时过去了。最后，就在他年轻的身体似乎再也无法承受的时候，凯德斯醒了。他的报告即将发表。
descriptions.en:
Against the protestations of the science team, §YKeides§! made the decision to sit upon the throne-like machine.

No sooner had he sat down, he lost consciousness.

Even as his expression slackened, his body was wracked by convulsions. No amount of effort from the science team was able to free him from the throne. Hours passed. Finally, just when it seemed his young body could bear no more, Keides awoke. His report is forthcoming.

options.script: name = paragon.3152.a

descriptions.zh:
§Y凯德斯§!看到了一座广场。广场上有成百上千个人。

大家面朝天空，看着一艘巨大的飞船从大气层外徐徐降落。就在此时一个声音响起：

“听着”它说，“审判之日就要到了。楔将会被夺走。你们应留在此地，直到一切的终结。”

人们的哭喊震耳欲聋。在他的幻视中，凯德斯意识到他的星球已经被抛弃了。他们的主人，一个拥有难以想象的力量的外星物种，发现他的人民缺乏潜力。楔（及其产生的虫洞）是连接他的星球和更广阔的星系的唯一途径。一旦与星系贸易切断往来，他的人民繁荣的基础就无可挽回地丧失了。
descriptions.en:
§YKeides§! saw a public square. Packed inside it were thousands, if not hundreds of thousands of people.

Faces turned to the sky, they watched as a massive ship descended from the upper atmosphere. At once a single voice boomed out.

'Attend,' it said. 'For the time of judgment is at hand. The Keys will be taken. Here you shall remain, until the end of all things.'

The cries of the people were deafening. In the midst of his vision, Keides understood that his world had been abandoned. Their masters, an off-world species of unimaginable power, had found his people lacking. The Keys (and the stable wormholes they produced) were all that connected his world to the wider galaxy. Cut off from galactic trade, the foundation of his people's prosperity was suddenly, and irretrievably, lost.

options.script: name = paragon.3153.a

descriptions.zh:
作为怜悯，瓦格罗人被宽限一个月内交出所有楔和相关材料。事实上，这与其说是怜悯，不如说是侮辱，因为这点时间根本不够他们自救。作为一颗行政管理行星是没有办法维持其庞大人口的。他们所能期望的最好结果就是定量配给他们所拥有的食物，让自己能晚一点挨饿。他们在外面的主人当然了然于胸。

然而，即使在绝望中，这颗星球的领袖也想出了一个计划。最近对高级冷冻保存和基因组学的试验结果基于了给了他们一个不一定能成功的机会。
descriptions.en:
As a mercy, the Vagrosians were given a month to yield all Keys and related materials. In truth, it was more insult than mercy and not nearly sufficient to save themselves. As an administrative world, the planet did not have the means to sustain its vast population. The best they could hope for was to ration what they had, delaying the time of their starvation. Their off-world masters were well aware of this.

However, even in their despair, the planet's leaders hatched a plan. Recent forays into advanced cryopreservation and genomics had afforded them an unlikely opportunity.

label.zh: 他们没有在沉默中死亡。肃然起敬。
label.en: So, they would not go quietly. Commendable.

options.script: name = paragon.3154.a

descriptions.zh:
当瓦格罗人的求生计划开始实施时，包含他们未来的“子嗣”§Y凯德斯§!被发射到太空中，同时被发射的还有他们最后一个楔的碎片，它被分解成四块，四散到星系各处以避免被发现。凯德斯出生时就没有父母，而是基因工程的产物。他的DNA中包含着对他的族人的记忆。当他成年时，只要接触到楔就可以通过幻视来获取这些记忆。

除了这个计划，这个行星的领袖还下令建造数千个冷冻舱和巨大的地下空间来容纳它们。在那里，最聪明的瓦格罗人可以一直休眠，等待“子嗣”的归来。他们确实如此，直到低温冷冻也无法继续支撑他们的身体。他们心智化为数据，在王位里等待着子嗣的归来。
descriptions.en:
As the Vagrosian survival plan was set into motion, the pod containing their would-be 'Scion' §YKeides§! was launched into space - and with it, a fragment of their last Key, broken into four pieces and sent across the galaxy to avoid detection. Keides was born without parents, the product of genetic engineering. Encoded within his very DNA lay the memories of his people. Upon his maturity, contact with the Key would allow him to access these memories in the form of visions.

Alongside this plan, the planet's leaders ordered the construction of thousands of cryostasis pods and the giant underground space to house them. There, the brightest Vagrosian minds could sleep, awaiting the Scion's return. And so they had, until the cryostasis could no longer support their bodies. Minds reduced to data, they waited for their Scion inside his throne.

options.script: name = paragon.3155.a

descriptions.zh:
为了不让他们白白牺牲，§Y凯德斯§!再次坐回到子嗣王座上。结果这一次事情很快并且一点也不剧烈地就完成了。他的人民的记忆就像溪水一样平静地涌进他的脑海。

有了他祖先的知识和记忆，挖掘工作很快就结束了。凯德斯的下一步行动是处理所有获得的数据，然后撰写报告。
descriptions.en:
So as not to squander their sacrifice, §YKeides§! once more sat upon the Scion's throne. This time it proved a shorter and less dramatic affair. The memories of his people entered him with the tranquility of a flowing stream.

With his ancestors' knowledge and memories in hand, the excavation was shortly concluded. Keides's next course of action is to process all the obtained data and then report back.

label.zh: 很好。我们期待他的汇报。

descriptions.zh:
§H凯德斯的耷拉着肩，失去了一贯的活力。最近的事件似乎让他倍感疲惫。不过，他依然面带释然的微笑。§!

我得到了答案。其中有好有坏，但我很高兴找到了它们。
descriptions.en:
§HKeides's shoulders are slumped, his usual vigor diminished. It would seem recent events have taken their toll. Still, he wears an easy smile.§!

I have my answers. They may be bittersweet, but I am glad to know them.

label.zh: 你没有让列祖列宗丢脸。
